entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to lower to 200 metres this evening and to sea level early Tuesday morning. Expect 2 to 4 cm (possibly more) above 200 metres, and lesser amounts lower down.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: A few snow showers are expected this evening and Tuesday morning. Up to 1 cm may accumulate at times.
